visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women stand ready in a spacious, professional dance studio. The woman on the left has long blonde hair and wears a gray long-sleeved crop top with black athletic pants. The woman on the right has dark hair and wears a light blue crop top with a black mini-skirt. The room has light wood flooring and a gray paneled wall under bright overhead spotlights. (2) The pair begins a synchronized, high-energy dance routine. They move their arms in wide arcs and perform rhythmic side-steps and hip movements in perfect unison. The camera remains fixed at eye-level, capturing their full-body silhouettes against the neutral background. (3) The choreography intensifies with faster arm motions and hair flips. Both dancers maintain focused but joyful facial expressions as they execute sharp, controlled movements. The studio lighting remains bright and consistent, emphasizing the clean lines of their dance. (4) The dance concludes with an energetic final pose. The blonde woman smiles broadly, walks towards the camera, and begins clapping her hands enthusiastically. Her face is shown in a close-up at the very end, reflecting a sense of accomplishment and happiness.
